messages:
Aria: FYI onboarding sampleapp tripped on rerank today. Looks like SDKs disagree on which embedding-length key is authoritative (header vs payload).
Leo: Any diffs?
Aria: Yep. Python client sends `dim` in the payload and Go batcher sends an HTTP header `X-Embedding-Length: 2048`. Server validated header first and then body and raised: "length header 2048 != len(values) 2047".
Nikhil: Oh neat. We historically accepted header for fast routing but never enforced canonicalization. If header disagrees with actual array we should prefer the array length.
Zoe: Were there auth retries around the incident? We saw a 401/refresh sequence on staging earlier.
Aria: There was a token refresh during the run, but the two outbound requests were identical in values. The header came from the Go batcher, which increments a counter while building the HTTP request; if a reslice happens during concat it might report capacity instead of actual length.
Leo: Could be off-by-one in the concat path where we append a pad token for alignment then trim, but header gets set before trim.
Nikhil: Short-term patch: server should ignore X-Embedding-Length and compute canonical_dim = len(values). If mismatch, return 400 with message: "declared length header X != actual len Y; server uses actual len(Y)". That will help DX.
Zoe: Agreed. Also SDKs: remove competing metadata channels. Go-sdk: stop sending X-Embedding-Length or set it only from len(values) after serialization. Python: ensure it sets `dim` in body and don't add header.
Aria: I'll open a tiny sampleapp PR to drop header in Go and add a test that asserts the server rejects if header mismatches.
sdk-bot: Created ticket INF-4277: "canonicalize embedding length: ignore headers, derive from payload".
infra-bot: Canary updated to run shape-validate middleware (pipeline #6921).
Nikhil: Add a unit in go-sdk batcher: after building the values slice do `declared := len(values); header = strconv.Itoa(declared)` (no pre-declare). And add a regression test that simulates a reslice/append race and fails if header != actual.
Leo: For DX docs: add a short note in SDK dev guide: "Do not rely on X-Embedding-Length or other metadata; always compute length from values and keep SDKs consistent."
Zoe: Also add an e2e in devex harness that runs python+go sampleapps together to detect cross-SDK parity issues early.
Aria: Quick win: server middleware will now log mismatches with an explicit hint and a link to INF-4277. That should save support tickets.
Nikhil: Will follow up with PRs to go-sdk and server. Thanks for the quick triage.
Aria: I'll paste PR links here when ready. Ping me if you want to pair on the test harness. :raised_hands:
